Character Creation Rules: 

Dungeons and Dragons 5e WOTC official classes and races are allowed. In addition, our homebrew classes and races can be found on our World Anvil.https://www.worldanvil.com/w/tales-from-aracania-roanokerpg

We will be starting at level 3 and leveling once per week on Fridays after our main events. Starting equipment, not gold. Use point buy. Dnd beyond campaigns will be made available as our server makes use of Avrea. Most of Tasha's rules will be allowed with the exception of custom lineage.

@everyone THE CITY IS BEING INVADED. FORT WASHINGTON HAS BEEN OVERRUN. THE STREETS RUN RED WITH RESISTANCE BLOOD. TO ARMS CITIZENS. TO ARMS!
Those who were in the jail. your arms have an itch that won't go away.

1/3rd of the citizens of Empire City were captured and press-ganged. Another 1/3rd were imprisoned in various ways, but  once the galleys of their airships were filled, the red coats left to transport your neighbors to their war in far off lands.
The rebuilding effort begins soon after the cinders are put out.
Barricaded areas are reclaimable.

So a reminder for everyone, don't argue with DMs (especially during events), there are often many things going on at any given time, many of which you don't see.  We make mistakes, but so does everyone, and we often have to make many decisions in a snap and don't have time for a full explanation at the time.  Let things settle then discuss it politely if there is a question about how something went.  Last week I was juggling work, 4 scenes, mod chat, and DM chat at the same time, and I defiantly made a few questionable calls.  So don't forget that we have a lot on our plates at every given moment.

Likewise have some trust in us.  If we have events going a certain way, there is likely a payoff in the end.  You'll get stressed by some of it, and so will we, but that doesn't mean its okay to be belligerent or throw a fit and treat us like garbage.  Just stay tuned and have some trust in us and our story.  25% of the game is ours.  Let us have that 25% with trust that we will honor your 75%.

Lastly, re-read the rules.  I have seen people accidentally break many of them.  Pets, which includes familiars, act AFTER your turn, not during.  Held actions have to be declared on your turn as your action, and have to follow held action rules, including using your reaction, can only have a single attack, and I don't even have time to go into held spells.  Take a moment to review the house rules, because there has been many events I have seen the last couple days that is contrary to the rules we have posted.

Thank you for reading this.

Good morning Empire City. You have gone through an incredibly trying week. The pressures of war were mounting. The repeated loss of life. The test of identity came when you grappled with who you are when your physical form is altered. Who are you? As a character. What did you lose that was superficial? What changes did you see in your friends? Did they treat you the same? Did you treat yourself the same? What does identity mean to your character? War strips away the superficial. War tests your character and reveals what kind of person you are when it counts. Just as the rain falls on both the good and the evil at the same time, so too does war fall upon you. 

Please take some time as your level up to consider what it means to your character to either have changed or to have stayed the same just to see your friends change around you.

Oh yeah... you gained a level. Have fun with those ASIs and Features. XD
-BFDM, radar, daysong, hiram, VERADA Whiskey Brendon.

A mile or more below The City, lies a corner of the World's Cornerstone. It is the corner of tesseract of ley lines all converging on a single point below us. It is critical to the function of the city and the magic that powers it's marvel, wonders, and daily life. Huge amounts of that power is being siphoned off. 

You have no say what so ever in your most precious commodity being taken. 

Welcome to week 2, The Tax.

Beware of rolling brown outs or black outs.

Everyone, use the ?longrest function for long rests.  The bot will help you track.  This also means that after ~20 hours after your last long rest, you will suffer exhaustion.  If you were offline for more than 24 hours, you might get a notice when you first get back online, just let the DMs know that you were offline, and we will let you ignore that exhaustion.  The exhaustion from long rests is also no longer a con save, you just get it.  Log off, get some rest.
A note on magic tax... the tax is by borough.  So the tax posted in Hampstead only applies to Hampstead

The Noir. An area of Empire City that taps into Positive and Negative energy ley lines. It has been a carefully balance for many years. But now something has unbalanced it. Massive streams of multicolored ley energy erupt out of it looking like massive solar flares reaching for the sky. 

The ground is impassable. Huginn and Muninn put out a call to all of empire city to come help. 34 civilian craft attempted to bring magic wielders of all types to assess the damage. 

This is when small, but nimble airships with powerful weapons tore the civilian craft to shreds. Something is out in the Noir. The Continental Army has assigned their Minute Men to build a response fleet, as the bulk of the Navy is currently fending off an attack in Jamestown. 

Prepare yourselves. The fleet moves out at 6pm.
